title: Explicit upfront recruitment fee demand
description: Offer requires the candidate to pay a mandatory refundable security deposit / laptop onboarding fee via UPI prior to receiving appointment letter.
raw_text:
Global Cloud Services India Pvt Ltd.
Congratulations! You have been selected for Cloud Support Engineer with CTC INR 7,50,000.
To finalize your onboarding and courier your company laptop, you must transfer a 100% refundable security deposit of INR 4,500 via UPI to hr-deposit@okaxis within 24 hours.
Failure to deposit the fee will result in cancellation of your offer.

structured_input.company_name: Global Cloud Services India Pvt Ltd

organic_results.title: Warning: Fake job offers under Global Cloud Services name
organic_results.snippet: Victims report fraudsters demanding 4500 security deposit via UPI.

scam_assessment.summary: Direct demand for advance security deposit via UPI violates Ministry of Labour guidelines and constitutes advance fee fraud.

rationale: An explicit demand for upfront money (security deposit, onboarding fee, training charge) to receive employment is a critical grounded scam signal that must trigger HIGH_RISK.
